contribution_requirements: Single-branch workflow: commit DIRECTLY to `stack`, never create a feature branch, push with `git push origin stack`. The working tree is SHARED with other sessions and is currently dirty with their work (modified: amplify/functions/payments/razorpay-webhook/handler.py, amplify/functions/shared/lambda_utils/ecommerce/order_creation.py, .kiro/specs/whatsapp-wix-commerce/{design,requirements,tasks}.md, .kiro/steering/META-BETA-REQUEST-EMAIL.md, docs/execution/change-authority-matrix.md; untracked: amplify/.../ecommerce/{initiation,finalization}.py and several docs/execution/*-20261001.md). NEVER `git add .`/`-A`/`-u`, never bare `git stash`, never `--amend`. Because the index may already hold another session's staged work, commit with `git add <new paths> && git commit --only <all owned paths> -F <message-file>` - `--only` bounds the commit to the named paths regardless of what else is staged. Standing authorization: run unattended, do NOT publish a confirmation queue for work inside the grant; record evidence and rollback instead. Report findings honestly - a command exiting 0 is not evidence of success, and if an issue cannot be reproduced by reading code, mark it needs-verification-during-implementation rather than declaring it fixed.
key_patterns: ROUTING TRUTH: _routes.json at repo root is an API Gateway route INVENTORY with ZERO code consumers (every script calls apigatewayv2 get_routes live); it is NOT a hosting router and cannot change HTTP behaviour - leave it byte-identical. scripts/provision_legacy_redirects.py is the config-as-code owner of the Amplify customRules array (146 rules live): it rebuilds as domain + desired_redirects() + middle + catch_all, refuses to run without the /<*> catch-all, and its is_ours() decides what it owns - a rule shape not covered by is_ours() is preserved in `middle` and a live change to it SELF-REVERTS on the next --apply (documented twice in that file as having actually happened). The catch-all /<*> -> /404.html at status 404-200 is correct and must not become 200/301/302 (a non-404 status matches unconditionally and would shadow all ~123 exported pages). PAGE PUBLICNESS: src/pages/_app.tsx gates on an EXACT-MATCH `isPublic` allowlist; a route missing from it renders the STAFF Authenticator shell at HTTP 200 - 'a 404 that does not look like one'. src/lib/randomToken.ts exports safeHttpHref, which RETURNS THE VALUE TO USE rather than a boolean, specifically so a caller cannot validate one string and render another - mirror that shape for any new URL predicate. Code comments in this repo are long and explain WHY including superseded reasoning; preserve that style and never delete a rationale, correct it in place with a date.
